annotations.title: Save standard answers used on every application

description: Save standard answers used on every application. Right to work, sponsorship, salary expectation, notice period, relocation and more, plus answers to any specific question (answers: {question: answer}). Waiting applications that needed these get them at once. Questions about gender, ethnicity, disability and similar are never answered unless the person gives an answer. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.
